spawn_gazebo.options.title: Spawn Gazebo
spawn_gazebo.options.on_server: On a server, the server's settings apply
spawn_gazebo.options.spawnGazebo.tooltip: A little round stone gazebo at the world spawn of new worlds, with pillars of the wood that grows around it and a green copper dome. Only takes effect when a world is created.
spawn_gazebo.options.starterChest.toolti: A chest in the gazebo's railing, like the bonus chest. Later players get the same loot handed to them, or their own chest with Lootr. Only takes effect when a world is created.
spawn_gazebo.options.chestLoot.tooltip: What the starter chest holds. Starter Kit: a bed, torches, bread, saplings and a bundle. Bonus Chest: the random tools, wood, food and seeds of vanilla's bonus chest. Any other loot table can be named in the config file. Only takes effect when a world is created.
spawn_gazebo.options.protectGazebo.toolt: The gazebo can only be changed in creative, and explosions, fire and pistons leave it alone. The chest, the benches and the pots still work. Turn off to remodel it.
spawn_gazebo.options.protectedRadius.too: How far from the middle of the gazebo the protection reaches, in blocks. 7 is the gazebo itself; more keeps the ground around it as it was too.
spawn_gazebo.command.overworld_only: The gazebo can only be built in the Overworld.
spawn_gazebo.command.ask: This builds a gazebo centred here (%s, %s): trees and blocks in a 15 by 15 area are cleared and built over, and the world spawn and the protection move to it.
spawn_gazebo.command.ask_old: The old gazebo near %s, %s stays standing, but is no longer protected.
spawn_gazebo.command.ask_confirm: Type /spawngazebo build confirm within 30 seconds to build it.
spawn_gazebo.command.nothing_to_confirm: Nothing to confirm: run /spawngazebo build first, where you want the gazebo.
spawn_gazebo.command.failed: Couldn't build the gazebo here; the server log says why.
spawn_gazebo.command.built: Built the gazebo; the world spawn is now in it (%s, %s, %s).
spawn_gazebo.command.already_here: There's already a gazebo here (near %s, %s). Stand at least 15 blocks from it to build another.
spawn_gazebo.command.moved: The gazebo was built where you stood, so you've been moved up onto its floor.
